title: FAQ
bodyHtml:
FAQ

Short answers and links to deep FAQ pages for access, email, and performance.

Common questions

This index points at the full FAQ articles in this handbook. Each child page is self-contained with steps and checks.

QuestionGuide

Cannot log in or need demo accessDemo access and login

How do agents automate?CLI and keys
How do I get on the demo?Demo host access

Still stuck

Confirm host URL, role, and whether you are on demo versus local. Capture correlation ids from failed API JSON when available. Avoid pasting secrets into shared tickets. For deploy failures, see Operations; for authz failures on CLI, see exit code 2 in CLI and keys.
